## How the score was worked out

Each result implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average, with a small pull toward the middle for thinly tested models. Each test's weight is its *counts* column above; here it is added up by who ran the tests. ## How to run it

### Other ways to run it

1. Run it as published (fp16, needs ~4.22 GB, from [github.com/openai](https://github.com/openai/whisper))
   
   ```sh
   uvx --from openai-whisper whisper audio.mp3 --model large-v1
   ```

Other versions: fp32 (~7.94 GB) `uv run --with transformers --with torch python -c "from transformers import pipeline; print(pipeline('automatic-speech-recognition', model='openai/whisper-large')('audio.wav', return_timestamps=True)['text'])"`

Official weights and documentation: [huggingface.co/openai](https://huggingface.co/openai/whisper-large)

[interactive version](https://whatmodel.sh/model/whisper-large) · [JSON](https://whatmodel.sh/api?format=json&all=1)
